author: nickdigger
body:
After reading avicus.net/rules and confirming with an admin, there is no rule pertaining "ddos threats" therefore, you cannot ban me for a rule that doesn't exist.

Evidence: avicus.net/rules
[6/6/15 10:31:52 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: is there a rule against threatening to ddos?
[6/6/15 10:39:55 PM] Michael: yes
[6/6/15 10:43:30 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: link?
[6/6/15 10:46:13 PM] Michael: Avicus.net/rules
[6/6/15 10:46:24 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: no, the actual rule itself
[6/6/15 10:47:39 PM] Michael: oh
[6/6/15 10:47:39 PM] Michael: uh
[6/6/15 10:47:44 PM] Michael: it doesn't seem to exist
[6/6/15 10:47:47 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: ya
[6/6/15 10:47:47 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: ik
[6/6/15 10:47:52 PM] bolin chen [the real naydur]: unban pls :)

Thanks
Moonman (K^3)
K meaning Kindness

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Poolday/Grace,
After being in the face of leniency for the longest time, you're about to hit the other side of the spectrum. You've been pretty racist, rude and overall obnoxious throughout the community. And in response, I'm going to say that we're done being lax and nice with you. You're getting unbanned because you found one minor loophole in the rules, but next time we're going to be more than strict, and we'll use common sense and guidelines to punish you. If we see any rudeness, crude joking, anything racist or about the KKK of any sort, including on TeamSpeak with use of your soundboard, and it will be all over and you will never, ever have another chance. DDoS threats will be added to the rules, and watching you will be added to our list of things to do. Expect extreme monitoring of you and your actions for the rest of your time on the Avicus Network. Thank you.

Regards,

Rinn, Avicus Network Administrator.
